story: On a sunny Monday evening at 6:17, Gary is heading home to Gary's House along Magnolia Loop, looking determined about his plans. Over at the Rec Center, Donna is warming up on pickleball court one with solo serves and dinks, getting ready for Gary to arrive. Hal and Rosa are still on Magnolia Loop, where Hal grudgingly admits her sketches look orderly and agrees to walk over with her and Gary at nine the next morning, while Rosa, feeling hopeful, invites him to join them.
events: Donna (pickleball court 1): Warm up with some solo serves and dinks before Gary arrives

gary.thought_process: I've already told Rosa I'd finish my wiring sketches tonight, and Hal's got my word that nothing gets bolted on before Review signs off. Nobody's asking me anything right now and I've said my piece, so more talk would just repeat myself. The board is empty, the sketches won't draw themselves, and I'm better at diagrams than chatter. Heading home to my workbench to get the wiring plan done so Rosa can carry both sets to the committee. It also feels good to be needed for this.

parameters.content: Heading home to my workbench to finish the wiring sketches so Rosa can take them to Review.

donna.thought_process: I'm at the Rec Center alone with a court booked and Gary due for practice. I already checked the kiosk and the ladder board in the last couple of ticks, so no need to repeat those. Nobody's in line-of-sight, and the best use of the hour is to warm up on court 1 so I can show Gary some real drills when he arrives. That's the first step toward climbing past Pruitt-Kowalski.

parameters.content: Warm up with some solo serves and dinks before Gary arrives

hal.thought_process: Rosa has handed me the sketches and Gary swears nothing gets bolted on before Review signs off. The board is empty, so no approval yet. Neither of them is dodging the process, and that counts for something. Rosa offered to walk the sketches to the committee tomorrow and invited me along. That's the by-the-book move, so I'll accept, and I'll remind them the flamingo count is next on my list so Donna doesn't get a surprise. Don't repeat earlier lines, just close this out and move things forward.

parameters.content: Sketches look orderly, Rosa. I'll walk over with you tomorrow morning, nine sharp, and I'll hold you both to it: nothing gets bolted on until the committee stamps it.

rosa.thought_process: Gary and Hal are both here and we've just covered the board situation. Gary will finish his sketches tonight and I'll carry both sets to the committee tomorrow. I shouldn't repeat my offer or ask again. The dinner got everyone at one table, which was my goal, and the cart plan is moving. Now I should wrap up warmly and propose a concrete next step, a time tomorrow morning to meet and walk the sketches over together, so Hal feels included in the process and Gary has a deadline.

parameters.content: Sounds good, Gary. Bring your sketches by my place tomorrow around nine and we'll walk both sets over to the committee together. Hal, the offer's open if you want to come along.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
